Name: QuickSelect
Author: thisisyorknife
Description:
[b][size=5]QuickSelect[/size][/b]
[size=4][i]Stop fumbling through your toolbar mid-combat.[/i]
Bind any inventory item to a key combo and equip it instantly with one press — [b]on keyboard or controller.[/b][/size]

[line]
[b][size=5]Main Features [/size][/b][b][size=3](SEE UPDATE NOTES BELOW FOR NEWLY ADDED FEATURES!)[/size][/b]

[size=3][b]Custom Keybinds — Keyboard & Controller[/b]
- Bind any single key or multi-key combo to an inventory item.
- On keyboard: Ctrl+1 for your sword. Shift+2 for your pickaxe.
- On controller: L1+Square for your sword. L1+Triangle for your pickaxe.
- Mix and match however you want.  Auto-Use Consumables + Swap Back
- Toggle this in settings and food, bombs, and staircases get automatically used when you swap to them — then you swap right back to what you were holding.[/size]
- Drop a bomb mid-combat without losing your sword  - Eat food on the fly without breaking stride  - Place a staircase and keep moving 

[size=3][b]Works Across All Toolbar Rows[/b][/size]
[size=3]- Item on row 3? No problem. QuickSelect automatically shifts your toolbar to the right page, whether you have 2 or 3 rows unlocked.
 [/size]
[b]How to Use[/b]
- Hold an item and press F1 (keyboard) or hold Select for a couple  seconds (controller)  - Choose Item!  - Press your desired key/combo 
- Done! Press that combo anytime to instantly equip. 
[size=3]- Hold ~ (tilde) to clear all bindings[/size]

[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
[size=3]- Stardew Valley 1.6+  [/size]
[size=3]- SMAPI 4.0+Recommended that you configure this plugin with Generic Mod Config Menu![/size]
[line]
[b][size=5]QuickSelect 1.2.0 - MAJOR update! Tons of bug fixes![/size][/b]
[line]
[b][size=4]Fixes/Improvements:[/size][/b]

[b]+ Animations are fixed[/b]
    - Warp totems/return scepter
    - Item pickups, harvesting
    - Kissing your spouse + other actions, ALL FIXED.

Sorry to those who had issues. I wouldn't have used the mod either if warp totems didn't work, that is lowkey unacceptable. Hope y'all stuck around to try it again!

[b]+ Reactive overlay[/b]
    - Bindings hide by default. Hold any modifier (Ctrl/Shift/Alt/L1/R1/D-pad) and only the slots bound to that modifier reveal themselves. No more overlapping labels.

[b]+ Improved Controller Experience[/b]
    - D-pad is a modifier now, toggleable in GMCM (defaults on).

[b]+ ToolPouch compatibility[/b]
    - If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25136]ToolPouch[/url], bound items inside the pouch get pulled out and equipped automatically. Zero config.

[b]+ Better visuals / Improved UI[/b]
    - Custom icons for Shift/Ctrl/Alt/D-pad arrows
    - Modifiers always render left of the key
    - Bolder, crisper text
    - Ctrl+3 shows as Ctrl+3, not Ctrl+D3

[b]+ Better signaling / On screen cues / Other Fixes[/b]
    - Ctrl+A and other WASD chords now show "Cant use W, A, S, or D in keybinds!" instead of silently binding just Ctrl
    - Multi-modifier combos no longer get hijacked by existing binds mid-setup
    - Hold ~ for 3 seconds to clear all bindings (was broken in 1.1.0, works now, with a centered countdown)
    - SMAPI update checks now wired up (Nexus:44679)
    - Active slot draws topmost on any visual collision
    - Auto-migrates your config if you're upgrading from 1.1.x

[b]Coming soon TM[/b]
    - Per-save bindings, separate controller clear-all button.
[size=4]
[b]Installation[/b][/size]
- Drop entire QuickSelect directory into Mods directory.
- Set some hotkeys and enjoy!
- Hold modifiers to see the interactive hotkey display in action!

Add a post/bug report if you have any issues, I will get to you, eventually! Even if you want some obscure mod compatibility, I will do my best to come through, as shown here with ToolPouch!


[line]
[size=5]PREVIOUS PATCH NOTES[/size]
[line]
[b] QuickSelect 1.1.0 Update!
 Visual + performance update
[/b]- bound items get a teal outline on the toolbar so you can see at a glance whats bound
- the button combo shows right above each bound slot, no more forgetting what you set
- controller face buttons render as actual button art (xbox + ps button pixel art that took me forever)
- added a config option to pick if you use sony or xbox style buttons, labels swap accordingly
- fixed certain situations that would render the player stuck and unable to move
- fixed circle button opening the inventory menu when used in a keybind combo
